name: testland/dependabot-config
description: Reference for .github/dependabot.yml - GitHub-native dependency-update orchestrator. Required keys (version: 2, updates[] array), per-update fields (package-ecosystem, directory/directories, schedule.interval), optional fields (ignore, groups, allow, versioning-strategy), plus grouped-PR and security-only updates. Config-authoring, not scanning: renovate-config is the multi-platform (GitLab/Bitbucket/Azure DevOps) equivalent; to find vulnerable versions run snyk-test, osv-scanner, or npm-pip-maven-audit.
